description: This file defines a singleton class 'SettingsWindowOpener' responsible for managing the opening of the settings or preferences window within a macOS application. It includes a protocol for menu actions and provides fallback logic if a custom settings action is not registered.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class that manages opening the settings or preferences window, either by a registered action or by sending appropriate menu actions.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a custom open settings action that will be invoked when opening the settings window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Activates the application and attempts to open the settings window via a registered action or by simulating menu actions.
